## Problem

LP-0MTYARXXZ002VNF5 fixed log discovery in the proxy-usage-analysis skill (dash-named + gzipped rotated files). Four sibling scripts each carry their own copy of the same discovery logic and still hardcode the dot-only pattern, so they silently drop dash-named logrotate files and gzipped files exactly as the skill did:

| Script | Line | State |
|---|---|---|
| proxy/scripts/analyze_context_distribution.py | 229-238 | dot-only (name.startswith('proxy.log.')) |
| proxy/scripts/run_compaction_experiment.py | 233-239 | dot-only |
| proxy/scripts/correlate_oversized_sessions.py | imports from analyze_context_distribution | inherits the bug |
| scripts/slot-persistence-correlate.py | 81-84 | dot-only (glob('proxy.log.*')) |

## Why this keeps recurring

scripts/slot_persistence_harness.py:60-70 was already patched for this, with an explicit comment:

    Two rotation naming schemes coexist:
      old: proxy.log.2026-08-22_01.gz
      new: proxy.log-2026-08-27_00.gz

That fix was applied to one script in isolation. Each script has its own discover_log_files, so every naming/compression change re-breaks the others. LP-0MSISZS1O004KJRR previously fixed this same class of bug for the dot scheme, only for the dash scheme to reintroduce it.

## Proposed remediation

Extract a single shared helper for proxy log discovery + text opening (including .gz decompression) and have all five call sites use it. Candidates: a small shared module under proxy/utils.py (already the log-config home) or a scripts/lib. Add a regression test asserting both naming schemes, plain and .gz, for the shared helper.

## Acceptance criteria

1. A single shared helper resolves proxy log files (live + dot + dash, plain + .gz).
2. All four listed scripts use the shared helper; no local dot-only copy remains (grep for 'proxy.log.').
3. Each script's existing tests pass and at least one new test per script covers a dash-named and/or gzipped input.
4. The skill's log_parser.open_log_text is reused or the logic is shared, not duplicated.
data.title: Consolidate proxy log-file discovery: 4 sibling scripts still hardcode dot-only naming and miss gzipped/dash logs
